description: The one fixed problem P that experiments 1 to 4 solve, and whose flow and pigment settings experiment 5 uses. The 1 x 1 basin on 1024 x 1024 cells; the number of steps is provisional (a serial run takes about 8 minutes on a laptop). Time one run on Atlas or Vanda, then adjust them here, in this one place. The settings are written out in full, so that a change of config/defaults.json cannot change a benchmark.
